text_en: Hear this, O house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and who came forth from the loins of Judah; who swear by the name of the Lord , and invoke the God of Israel, but not in truth or right.
text_cn: 雅各伯家请听这话：──你们以以色列的名字自称，出自犹大之后，奉上主的名字起誓，又称扬“以色列的天主，”但都不是出自诚心诚意；

text_en: For they call themselves after the holy city, and lean on the God of Israel; the Lord of hosts is his name.
text_cn: 虽然你们自称是出自圣城，依赖名为“万军上主”的以色列的天主──

text_en: The former things I declared long ago, they went out from my mouth and I made them known; then suddenly I did them and they came to pass.
text_cn: “那过去的事，我早就预言过了，由我口中所发出的，也叫人听见了；转瞬间我行了那事，那事也就成就了。

text_en: Because I know that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew and your forehead brass,
text_cn: 因为我知道你是顽固的，你的颈项似铁杠，你的额是铜制的，

text_en: I declared them to you from long ago, before they came to pass I announced them to you, so that you would not say, “My idol did them, my carved image and my cast image commanded them. ”
text_cn: 为此我早就告诉了你，在事未发生之前我就向你说明了，免得你说：‘是我的神像行了这事，是我雕刻铸成的神像命定了这事。’

text_en: You have heard; now see all this; and will you not declare it? From this time forward I make you hear new things, hidden things that you have not known.
text_cn: 你既听见了，也看见了这一切，难道你们不该作证吗？如今我要宣布新事，即你不知的隐密事。

text_en: They are created now, not long ago; before today you have never heard of them, so that you could not say, “I already knew them. ”
text_cn: 这些事是现今而不是从前造成的，是今日之前你从没有听说过的，免得你说：‘看，我早就知道了！’

text_en: You have never heard, you have never known, from of old your ear has not been opened. For I knew that you would deal very treacherously, and that from birth you were called a rebel.
text_cn: 你从来没有听过，也不知道，也是你的耳朵闻所未闻的。因为我知道你好背信叛逆，你实在可称为‘胎生的叛徒’。

text_en: For my name’s sake I defer my anger, for the sake of my praise I restrain it for you, so that I may not cut you off.
text_cn: 但是为了我名的缘故，我暂缓发怒；为了我荣誉的缘故，我抑制了我自己，而没有消灭你。

text_en: See, I have refined you, but not like silver; I have tested you in the furnace of adversity.
text_cn: 看啊！我只是锻炼了你，有如银子，在患难的炉中磨炼了你。

text_en: For my own sake, for my own sake, I do it, for why should my name be profaned? My glory I will not give to another.
text_cn: 为了我自己，为了我自己的缘故，我必要去行。我岂能让我的名字受亵渎？我决不将我的光荣让与别人。”

text_en: Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel, whom I called: I am He; I am the first, and I am the last.
text_cn: 雅各伯啊！我所召叫的以色列啊！你听我说：我就是那位，我是元始，我也是终末。

text_en: My hand laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand spread out the heavens; when I summon them, they stand at attention.
text_cn: 我的手奠定了大地，我的右手展开了诸天；我一叫它们，它们就一同出现。

text_en: Assemble, all of you, and hear! Who among them has declared these things? The Lord loves him; he shall perform his purpose on Babylon, and his arm shall be against the Chaldeans.
text_cn: 你们都集合起来听吧！邪神中有谁预言了这事呢？“我所爱的，必实行我的旨意： 攻击巴比伦和加色丁的苗裔。”

text_en: I, even I, have spoken and called him, I have brought him, and he will prosper in his way.
text_cn: 只有我，只有我预言了这事，召叫了他，引导了他，使他所行的道路顺利。

text_en: Draw near to me, hear this! From the beginning I have not spoken in secret, from the time it came to be I have been there. And now the Lord God has sent me and his spirit.
text_cn: 你们走近我前，听这话吧！我从起初就没有在暗处说过话，从实现之时起，我就在那里。我上主现在即要施行救援。

text_en: Thus says the Lord , your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: I am the Lord your God, who teaches you for your own good, who leads you in the way you should go.
text_cn: 你的救主上主，以色列的圣者这样说：“我是上主你的天主，教训你为你有益的事，引你走当走的道路。

text_en: O that you had paid attention to my commandments! Then your prosperity would have been like a river, and your success like the waves of the sea;
text_cn: 恨不得你一向听从我的命令！那么你的安乐将似江河，你的幸福将似海涛；

text_en: your offspring would have been like the sand, and your descendants like its grains; their name would never be cut off or destroyed from before me.
text_cn: 你的子孙多如海沙，出于你身的苗裔多似沙粒；你的名字在我前决不会抹去，也决不会被删除。”

text_en: Go out from Babylon, flee from Chaldea, declare this with a shout of joy, proclaim it, send it forth to the end of the earth; say, “The Lord has redeemed his servant Jacob! ”
text_cn: 你们出离巴比伦，逃出加色丁吧！你们要以欢乐的呼声宣告此事，叫人听见，传布到地极说：“上主救赎了他的仆人雅各伯。”

text_en: They did not thirst when he led them through the deserts; he made water flow for them from the rock; he split open the rock and the water gushed out.
text_cn: 当上主率领他们过旷野时，他们并不觉渴，因为他使水由岩石中流出给他们喝；他分开了岩石，水就涌流出来。

text_en: “There is no peace, ” says the Lord , “for the wicked. ”
text_cn: 上主说：恶人决无平安！
